title: RuntimeError in queue.pop when running a scheduled job
body:
## Environment

Lattice version 3.3.2; operating system Windows 11 24H2; server region ca-central-1.

## Steps

How to trigger it:
* With the log window open, start running a scheduled job.
* Install this release over the previous one without changing settings.
* Wait for the failure and read the log.

## Expected

No traceback; running a scheduled job normally takes a few seconds.

## Actual

Since upgrading, every attempt fails here. It began right after upgrading to this release; nothing else changed.

## Frequency

Happens every time.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:48 in loop
lattice/sched/runner.py:133 in run_due
lattice/sched/queue.py:81 in drain
lattice/sched/queue.py:113 in pop
RuntimeError: queue lock held by worker-2
